eyebrow.zh: 来源一变 · 下游即红 · 全图可见
eyebrow.en: Source changes · Claims go red · Full graph

headline.zh:
代理的结论
不再悄悄失效
headline.en:
Agent conclusions
never silently go stale

sub.zh: 每条结论回链到机器可查的来源片段；来源一变，依赖结论即被级联标记失效，在一张图上看得见。
sub.en: Every conclusion links to a machine-checkable source span; when a source changes, dependent claims are cascade-flagged stale — all visible on one graph.

title.zh: 结论回链来源，不是黑盒解释
title.en: Claims link to sources, not black-box explanations

body.zh: 每条代理结论都记录它从哪个文件片段、哪个模型版本、哪个网页推导而来——一个可查的数据流代理，不是事后编的理由。
body.en: Every agent conclusion records which file span, model version, or web URL it was derived from — a checkable dataflow trace, not a post-hoc rationalization.

chips: › 文件片段 / 模型版本 / 网页

body.zh: 编辑了来源文件？直接接地在上面的结论立刻被标记失效，并沿依赖链传递标记——Bazel 的 dirty-mark，但提升到代理结论节点。
body.en: Edited a source file? Claims grounded on it are flagged stale instantly, and the flag propagates along the dependency chain — Bazel dirty-marks lifted to agent-conclusion nodes.

title.en: See all provenance on one graph

body.zh: 所有结论-来源关系在一张交互式图上可见：哪条结论依赖哪个来源，哪条已经失效，一目了然。编辑来源后图上节点实时变红。
body.en: All claim-source relationships visible on one interactive graph: which conclusion depends on which source, which ones are stale — at a glance. Nodes turn red in real time after a source edit.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 本地运行 · 无需账号
tag.en: MIT open source · runs locally · no account
